Why it exists

AI moves faster than most people can use it.

There is no shortage of AI news. What is missing, especially for students and people early in their careers, is one idea a week they can act on.

AI This Week is that: a short read on building with AI, getting noticed and finishing what you start. Each edition takes one question and answers it properly.

What you get

Built for Students, builders and early-career professionals who want to use AI to learn, ship and get hired faster.

  1. 01

    Practical AI playbooks

    How to use AI tools to plan, build and finish real projects, not just start them.

  2. 02

    Career moves for the AI era

    Getting noticed, getting hired and working with the creators and companies you admire.

  3. 03

    The builder mindset

    Hackathons, side projects and shipping: what actually makes work stand out.

  4. 04

    Smarter studying

    AI tricks for exams, learning and beating the daily-limit wall.

  5. 05

    Five-minute reads

    One focused idea a week, with a bold collage cover you will recognise in your feed.

Decisions that shaped it

One idea per edition
No link round-ups. One question, answered in about five minutes.
Written for people starting out
Students, builders and early-career professionals, not people who already have a team and a budget.
A cover you can spot
Every edition gets a black, blue and lime collage, so you recognise it in a busy feed before you read the title.
